decision: The full intake explicitly makes mean-encoding representations swappable. Select expanding entity/store/item/category/global means and cyclical period features; learned embeddings, holiday and promotion features are alternative branches, not mandatory additional computations.

evidence.explicit_alternatives: Can use store, shop, item, category, day-of-week, month, holiday, promotion, target encoding, or learned entity embeddings.
evidence.earlier_mean_encoding: calculate the expanding mean of sales per shop and per item over time to generate robust continuous features

selected_computations.time_aggregation: Caller-defined periods and fixed store/item/category universe; compensated net transaction summation, absence means zero.
selected_computations.target_clipping: Clip net observed period/entity quantities to [0,20] only after summation. Preserve unknown forecast targets.
selected_computations.lag_feature_generation: All caller-configured lags and complete-width shifted rolling means, without current or future target access.
selected_computations.mean_encoding: Prior-only expanding means for entity/store/item/category/global populations and explicit cyclic period features, using the source-authorized encoding branch.
selected_computations.gbdt_modeling: LightGBM squared error with clipped-prediction RMSE validation, every configured TPE trial including model-based sampling, early stopping and final selected-round refit.

limits: The template is a generic benchmark topology with a competition landing-page citation, not a historical winning implementation.
Stage descriptions must be interpreted together with the explicit applicability/swappable_stages contract; isolated descriptions overstated the mandatory feature set in the previous readiness audit.
Do not claim implementation of omitted holiday, promotion or embedding branches. Cross-domain reuse requires the selected feature and observation-availability assumptions.

Clipping does not by itself replicate a competition evaluation metric. The realization declares its squared-error objective and clipped-prediction RMSE; no historical metric or accuracy equivalence is certified.
All configured trials and feature operations remain mandatory. This resolution does not approve providers, stored execution or the original CDG.
